content: संकॢप् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> To wish or long for. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To resolve, determine, settle. .²2 To intend, aim at, purpose; संकल्पितार्थे विवृतात्मशक्तिमाखण्डलः काममिदं बभाषे <ls>Ku. 3. 11</ls>. .²3 To arrange or connect together. .²4 To fix, assign, allot. .²5 To consecrate, dedicate. .²6 To imagine, fancy. .²7 To think about, ponder, reflect; देवेभ्य आगायद्यत् कल्याणं संकल्पयति तदात्मने <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 6</ls>. .²8 To perform obsequies.
